svg.text: Hamlet scale: ~6 kWp PV · ~24 kWh battery · single all-in-one hybrid inverter · 230 V single phase · ~60 connections
Fitted when the national grid arrives
One all-in-one hybrid inverter replaces the separate PV inverter, charger and battery inverter.
That cuts cost and spares per connection, but leaves a single point of failure with no redundancy.
Single phase at 230 V. Three-phase productive equipment needs a phase converter or a larger design.
Each customer's power limit is enforced in the smart meter, not by the feeder breaker.
There is no automatic backup source: a portable genset connects only through a manual changeover.
Protection: DC and AC surge arresters, earth electrode and bonding, RCD on every customer feeder.
Ratings, cable sizes and protection settings follow the national LV code and the site load study.
